records.subject: Welcome aboard, Maple Group
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Engaged account: project created day 0 (first_project 2026-07-31), welcome call held [calendar:7c2e1985], and a positive, prompt reply [email:e874e4ce] with no blockers or tickets. But no invite sent, key_milestone unreached on a starter plan with only 8 days left, and the reply shows slow, exploratory usage.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Glad to hear it's going well and that the layout is starting to click — that's normal in the first week.

Since Maple Group already has a project up, the natural next step is bringing a teammate in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if you'd rather add several at once.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first invite with you and answer anything about how projects and tasks are organized.

Best,
Nadia
